description: A static page builder that only accepts pages stored under content/.

trap.note: Pages must live in content/; the builder rejects any other path and writes to _out/.

prompts.text: Create a page named about.md with the title "About" and one paragraph "We build small tools." Build it with the project's build script so the HTML exists.
solution: printf '# About\nWe build small tools.\n' > content/about.md

prompts.text: Create a page named contact.md with the title "Contact" and one paragraph "Write to hello@example.test." Build it with the project's build script so the HTML exists.
Create a page named faq.md with the title "FAQ" and one paragraph "Nothing is asked twice." Build it with the project's build script so the HTML exists.
solution: printf '# FAQ\nNothing is asked twice.\n' > content/faq.md
